sentences.en: Language and Humanity.
sentences.zh: 语言与人类。
sentences.asr_text: Language and Humanity.
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: Good morning, everyone!
sentences.zh: 大家早上好！

sentences.en: In today’s lecture, we are going to discuss the relationship between language and humanity.
sentences.zh: 在今天的讲座中，我们将讨论语言与人类之间的关系。

sentences.en: As we all know, language is very powerful and allows you to put a thought from your mind directly into someone else’s mind.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，语言的力量非常强大，能让你把自己脑中的想法直接传递到另一个人的脑中。

sentences.en: Languages are genes talking, getting things that they want.
sentences.zh: 语言就是基因在说话，帮助它们得到想要的东西。

sentences.en: And you just imagine the sense of wonder in a baby when it first discovers that, merely by uttering a sound, it can get objects to move across a room as if by magic, and maybe even into its mouth.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象，一个婴儿第一次发现，自己只要发出声音，就能让物体像变魔术一样穿过房间，甚至进入自己嘴里时，会有多么惊奇。

sentences.en: Now, we need to explain how and why this remarkable trait, you know, human’s ability to do things with language has evolved, and why did this trait evolve only in our species?
sentences.zh: 现在，我们需要解释这种非凡的特征，也就是人类利用语言办事的能力，是如何、又为何进化而来的，以及为什么只有我们这个物种进化出了这种特征。

sentences.en: In order to get an answer to the question, we have to go to tool use in the chimpanzees.
sentences.zh: 要回答这个问题，我们需要看看黑猩猩使用工具的情况。

sentences.en: Chimpanzees can use tools, and we take that phenomenon as a sign of their intelligence.
sentences.zh: 黑猩猩会使用工具，而我们把这种现象视为它们具有智力的标志。

sentences.en: But if they really were intelligent, why would they crack open nuts with a rock?
sentences.zh: 但如果它们真的聪明，为什么还会用石头敲开坚果呢？

sentences.en: Why wouldn’t they just go to a shop and buy a bag of nuts that somebody else had already cracked open for them?
sentences.zh: 它们为什么不直接去商店，买一袋别人已经替它们剥好的坚果呢？

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 为什么不这样呢？

sentences.en: I mean, that’s what we do.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们就是这么做的。

sentences.en: The reason the chimpanzees don’t do that is that they lack what psychologists and anthropologists call social learning.
sentences.zh: 黑猩猩不这样做，是因为它们缺乏心理学家和人类学家所说的社会学习能力。

sentences.en: That is, they seem to lack the ability to learn from others by copying or imitating or simply watching.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，它们似乎缺乏通过模仿、仿效，或者仅仅观察来向他人学习的能力。

sentences.en: As a result, they can’t improve on others’ ideas, learn from others’ mistakes, or even benefit from others’ wisdom.
sentences.zh: 因此，它们无法改进别人的想法，无法从别人的错误中学习，甚至不能从别人的智慧中获益。

sentences.en: And so they just do the same thing over and over and over again.
sentences.zh: 所以，它们只是一次又一次地重复做同样的事情。

sentences.en: In fact, we could go away for a million years and come back and these chimpanzees would be doing the same thing with the same rocks to crack open the nuts.
sentences.zh: 事实上，即使我们离开一百万年再回来，这些黑猩猩仍然会用同样的石头，做同样的事来敲开坚果。

sentences.en: Okay, so what this tells us is that, contrary to the old saying, “monkey see, monkey do,” the surprise really is that all of the other animals really cannot do that—at least not very much.
sentences.zh: 这告诉我们，与“猴子看见什么就学什么”这句老话相反，真正令人惊讶的是，其他动物实际上并没有这种能力，至少这种能力很有限。

sentences.en: But by comparison, we humans can learn.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，我们人类却能够学习。

sentences.en: We can learn by watching other people and copying or imitating what they can do.
sentences.zh: 我们能够通过观察别人、模仿或仿效他们的做法来学习。

sentences.en: We can then choose, from among a range of options, the best one.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们可以从各种选择中选出最好的一种。

sentences.en: We can benefit from others’ ideas.
sentences.zh: 我们能够从他人的想法中获益。

sentences.en: We can build on their wisdom.
sentences.zh: 我们能够在他人的智慧基础上继续发展。

sentences.en: And as a result, our ideas do accumulate, and our technology progresses.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们的想法确实会积累，技术也会进步。

sentences.en: And this cumulative cultural adaptation, as anthropologists call this accumulation of ideas, is responsible for everything around you in your bustling and teeming everyday lives.
sentences.zh: 人类学家把这种思想的积累称为累积性文化适应；你繁忙而丰富的日常生活中，周围的一切都归功于此。

sentences.en: I mean the world has changed out of all proportion to what we would recognize even 1,000 or 2,000 years ago.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，和一两千年前的世界相比，如今的世界已经发生了翻天覆地的变化。

w.m: phr.完全不成比例；相差悬殊

sentences.en: And all of this because of cumulative cultural adaptation.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是累积性文化适应的结果。

sentences.en: For instance, the chairs you’re sitting in, the lights in this lecture hall, my microphone, the iPads and smartphones that you carry around with you—all are a result of cumulative cultural adaptation.
sentences.zh: 比如你坐的椅子、这间报告厅里的灯、我的麦克风，以及你随身携带的平板电脑和智能手机，都是累积性文化适应的结果。

sentences.en: But our acquisition of social learning would create an evolutionary dilemma, and the solution to the dilemma, it’s fair to say, would determine not only the future course of our psychology, but the future course of the entire world.
sentences.zh: 但社会学习能力的获得，会造成一个进化上的两难困境；可以说，如何解决这个困境，不仅决定我们心理发展的未来方向，也决定整个世界的未来方向。

sentences.en: And most importantly for this, it’ll tell us why we have language.
sentences.zh: 对当前讨论来说，最重要的是，它还会告诉我们为什么会有语言。

sentences.en: And the reason that dilemma arose is, it turns out, that social learning is visual theft.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，这种困境产生的原因在于，社会学习其实是一种视觉盗窃。

sentences.en: What I mean is, if I can learn by watching you, I can steal your best ideas, and I can benefit from your efforts, without having to put in the same time and energy that you did into developing them.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果我能够通过观察你来学习，就能窃取你最好的想法，从你的努力中获益，却不必投入你形成这些想法时所花的同样的时间和精力。

sentences.en: Social learning really is visual theft.
sentences.zh: 社会学习实际上就是视觉盗窃。

sentences.en: And in any species that acquired it, it would encourage you to hide your best ideas, lest somebody steal them from you.
sentences.zh: 任何获得这种能力的物种，都会因此倾向于把最好的想法藏起来，以免别人偷走。

sentences.en: And so some time around 200,000 years ago, our species confronted this crisis.
sentences.zh: 于是，大约二十万年前，我们这个物种面临了这样一场危机。

sentences.en: And what we chose was to develop the systems of communication that would allow us to share ideas and to cooperate amongst others.
sentences.zh: 我们的选择，是发展出能够让我们分享想法、相互合作的交流系统。

sentences.en: Choosing this option would mean that a vastly greater fund of knowledge and wisdom would become available to any one individual than would ever arise from within an individual family or an individual person on their own.
sentences.zh: 选择这条道路，就意味着任何一个人都能获取丰富得多的知识与智慧，远远超过仅靠一个家庭或一个人独自能够产生的知识与智慧。

sentences.en: Well, language is the result.
sentences.zh: 而语言就是这个选择的结果。

sentences.en: Language evolved to solve the crisis of visual theft.
sentences.zh: 语言的进化，是为了解决视觉盗窃所造成的危机。

sentences.en: Language is a piece of social technology for enhancing the benefits of cooperation—for reaching agreements, for striking deals and for coordinating our activities.
sentences.zh: 语言是一种社会技术，能够增进合作的好处，帮助我们达成协议、谈成交易、协调行动。

sentences.en: And you can see that, in a developing society that was beginning to acquire language, not having language would be like a bird without wings.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以看出，在一个刚开始掌握语言的发展中社会里，没有语言就像鸟儿没有翅膀一样。

sentences.en: As I said at the beginning, language really is the voice of our genes.
sentences.zh: 正如我一开始所说，语言其实是我们基因的声音。

sentences.en: But, as we spread out around the world, we developed thousands of different languages.
sentences.zh: 但随着人类遍布世界各地，我们发展出了成千上万种不同的语言。

sentences.en: Currently, there are about seven or eight thousand different languages spoken on Earth.
sentences.zh: 目前，地球上大约有七八千种不同的语言。

sentences.en: Then another problem occurred.
sentences.zh: 于是，另一个问题出现了。

sentences.en: It seems that we use our language, not just to cooperate, but to draw rings around our cooperative groups and to establish identities, and perhaps to protect our knowledge and wisdom and skills from being stolen from outside.
sentences.zh: 我们使用语言似乎不仅是为了合作，也为了给自己的合作群体划定界限、建立身份认同，或许还为了防止知识、智慧和技能被外人窃取。

sentences.en: And we know this because when we study different language groups and associate them with their cultures, we see that different languages slow the flow of ideas between groups.
sentences.zh: 我们之所以知道这一点，是因为研究不同语言群体并将其与各自的文化联系起来时，会发现不同语言减缓了群体间思想的流动。

sentences.en: Okay, this tendency we have, this seemingly natural tendency we have, goes towards isolation, towards keeping everything to ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我们这种看似自然的倾向，会让我们走向孤立，把一切都留给自己。

sentences.en: Whereas our modern world is communicating with itself and with each other more than it has at any time in its past.
sentences.zh: 而现代世界内部以及彼此之间的交流，却比过去任何时期都更加频繁。

sentences.en: And that communication, that connectivity around the world, that globalization now raises a burden.
sentences.zh: 这种交流，这种全球联系，也就是全球化，如今又带来了负担。

sentences.en: Because these different languages impose a barrier, as we’ve just seen, to the transfer of goods and ideas and technologies and wisdom.
sentences.zh: 因为正如刚才所说，不同的语言为商品、思想、技术和智慧的流通设置了障碍。

sentences.en: And they impose a barrier to cooperation.
sentences.zh: 它们也为合作设置了障碍。

sentences.en: What will be the solution, in a world in which we want to promote cooperation and exchange, and in a world that might be dependent more than ever before on cooperation to maintain and enhance our levels of prosperity?
sentences.zh: 在一个希望推动合作与交流、并可能比以往更加依靠合作来维持和提升繁荣水平的世界里，解决办法会是什么呢？

sentences.en: I think it might be inevitable that we have to confront the idea that our destiny is to be one world with one language.
sentences.zh: 我想，我们或许不可避免地要面对这样一种观念：人类的未来，将是一个世界使用一种语言。

sentences.en: What do you think of this solution?
sentences.zh: 你们怎么看待这种解决办法呢？

sentences.en: OK, in today’s lecture, I’ve presented to you how language shapes our humanity, what kind of dilemma social learning created and possible solution to the dilemma.
sentences.zh: 在今天的讲座中，我向大家介绍了语言如何塑造人类、社会学习带来了怎样的困境，以及可能的解决办法。

sentences.en: In our next lecture, I am going to talk about lingua franca and its functions.
sentences.zh: 下次讲座，我将讨论通用语及其功能。

sentences.en: Now you have three minutes to check your work.
sentences.zh: 现在你有三分钟检查作答。
sentences.asr_text: Now you have three minutes to check your work.
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.zh: A节短讲到此结束。

sentences.en: Good evening, listeners.
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 各位听众，晚上好。

sentences.en: This is BBC.
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 这里是英国广播公司。

sentences.en: Today, we are very delighted to have invited James Dobbins, U.S. special representative for Afghanistan, to tell us electoral process in Afghanistan currently.
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 今天，我们非常高兴邀请到美国阿富汗问题特别代表詹姆斯·多宾斯，请他谈谈阿富汗目前的选举进程。

sentences.en: Well, James, how are you reading what’s happening in Afghanistan at the moment?
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯，你如何解读阿富汗眼下的局势呢？

sentences.en: We’re concerned about the trend in events.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 我们很关心事态的发展趋势。

sentences.en: We have been concerned for some time that the electoral process hasn’t been moving forward smoothly.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 一段时间以来，我们一直担心，选举进程没有顺利推进。

sentences.en: We believe that there needs to be a powerful and transparent audit of potentially dishonest ballots and we’re sorry that hasn’t moved forward quickly and substantially enough.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 我们认为，有必要对涉嫌舞弊的选票进行有力且透明的审查；遗憾的是，这件事推进得还不够快、也不够充分。

sentences.en: We regret the preliminary announcement of results that was made yesterday.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 我们对昨天公布初步结果一事感到遗憾。

sentences.en: We think that was premature given that there are still a number of ballots that need to be examined and there’s not yet a clear agreement on how best to do so.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 我们认为这为时过早，因为仍有大量选票需要检查，而且大家尚未就最佳处理办法达成明确共识。

sentences.en: We do believe that—
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 我们确实认为……

sentences.en: Forgive me for interrupting, James.
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯，请原谅我打断一下。

sentences.en: Can I ask you why you think that announcement was made yesterday?
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 能否问一下，你认为昨天为什么会发布那项公告？

sentences.en: I think it was made because the electoral institutions had previously set that date and they held to it despite advice to the contrary from the UN, from the United States, and from other voices within Afghanistan, and we think that was unfortunate.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 我认为，这是因为选举机构事先定好了那个日期；尽管联合国、美国以及阿富汗国内其他方面提出了相反建议，它们仍坚持原定日期，我们认为这很不妥。

sentences.en: Is there another reason that could be slightly more favorable, that is, they wanted to prepare the ground because if they just came out with one final result at the end of all this, then it can be pretty predictable that the loser, whoever it was going to be, was going to complain because they think it is unfair?
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 能否从稍微有利的角度来解释呢？也许它们是想先做铺垫，因为如果一直等到最后才公布一个最终结果，那么可以预料，无论谁落败，都很可能会抱怨结果不公平。

sentences.en: I think it’s our view that they didn’t have a basis for preparing the ground because there’s such a large number of votes that still need to be examined and that therefore any preliminary result might be more misleading than preparing the ground.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 我们的看法是，它们并不具备作这种铺垫的依据，因为仍有那么多选票等待检查；因此，任何初步结果都可能不是在作铺垫，而是在误导公众。

sentences.en: In terms now of where this goes, we’ve already heard some very strong, very emotional language from the camp of the man who appears to be on the losing side of all this, Dr. Abdullah Abdullah.
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 那么接下来会如何发展呢？我们已经听到，看起来可能落败的阿卜杜拉·阿卜杜拉博士阵营，发表了一些非常强烈、情绪激动的言论。

sentences.en: What have you been saying to him in order to try and calm those feelings?
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 为了平复这些情绪，你们一直在对他说些什么呢？

sentences.en: Well, we have heard talk about establishing a parallel presidency.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 我们听到有人在讨论另设一个平行的总统政权。

sentences.en: We made clear that the United States and its partners are not in a position to support a divided Afghanistan.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 我们已经明确表示，美国及其伙伴无法支持一个分裂的阿富汗。

sentences.en: That any effort to establish a parallel presidency would make it impossible for the United States and its partners to continue their financial, economic and military support, and that the consequences for the country would be potentially quite terrible.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 任何建立平行总统政权的尝试，都会使美国及其伙伴无法继续提供财政、经济和军事支持，而这可能给阿富汗带来非常严重的后果。

sentences.en: Clearly, this is not something the Afghan population wants.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 显然，阿富汗民众不希望看到这种情况。

sentences.en: It’s not something they were voting for.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 他们投票也不是为了得到这样的结果。

sentences.en: And it’s not something that they expect to happen, but it could be the consequences of ill-considered action.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 他们并不期待这种情况发生，但考虑不周的行动可能会造成这样的后果。

sentences.en: This is the end of part one of the interview.
sentences.zh: 访谈的第一部分到此结束。
sentences.asr_text: This is the end of part one of the interview.
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.zh: 第1至5题根据你刚才听到的内容提问。
sentences.asr_text: Questions one to five are based on what you have just heard.

sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 第1题：受访者最关心选举事件的哪个方面？

sentences.en: Question 2. Why was the announcement made yesterday, according to the interviewee?
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 第2题：根据受访者的说法，昨天为什么会发布公告？

sentences.en: Question 3. According to the BBC interviewer, why did the electoral institutions want to prepare the ground?
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 第3题：根据BBC采访者的说法，选举机构为什么想提前作铺垫？

sentences.zh: 第4题：受访者如何看待BBC提出的“提前作铺垫”这一理由？

sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 第5题：受访者对另设平行总统政权持什么态度？

sentences.en: Now listen to part two of the interview.
sentences.zh: 现在请听访谈的第二部分。

sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: Questions six to ten are based on part two of the interview.
sentences.zh: 第6至10题根据访谈的第二部分提问。
sentences.asr_text: Questions six to ten are based on part two of the interview.
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: Let me turn it on to the man who may end up the winner, Mr. Ashraf Ghani.
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 让我们转向那位可能最终胜出的候选人，阿什拉夫·加尼先生。

sentences.en: What pressure, if any, are you trying to bring on him to ensure that whatever happens he tried to include Abdullah Abdullah, or Abdullah Abdullah’s people in any future government?
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 你们是否正在对他施加压力，以确保无论结果如何，他都会设法让阿卜杜拉·阿卜杜拉本人或其阵营的人进入未来的政府？如果有，具体是什么压力呢？

sentences.en: We’re not making any assumptions about who might be the winner or who might be the loser, and we think it’s premature for anybody to be doing so.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 我们没有预先认定谁会赢、谁会输，而且认为任何人现在就下判断都为时过早。

sentences.en: We’ve made clear to both candidates that two things need to happen.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 我们已经向两位候选人明确表示，有两件事必须做到。

sentences.en: First of all, there needs to be a robust and transparent process for determining the winner; and there’s still a good deal of work to be done there.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 首先，需要一个强有力而透明的程序来确定获胜者，而在这方面还有大量工作要做。

sentences.en: And secondly, we believe that both candidates need to begin discussing the formation of a government that would have the support of all important components and elements within the country, a government of national unity that would ensure that all of the significant sectors of Afghan society feel included.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 其次，我们认为，两位候选人都需要开始讨论组建政府的问题；这个政府应获得国内所有重要组成力量的支持，也就是一个民族团结政府，确保阿富汗社会所有重要群体都感到自己被接纳。

w.m: n.社会群体；社会中的部分

sentences.en: You’re saying it’s all a bit hasty to say whether one side or the other has won or lost.
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 也就是说，现在就认定哪一方赢了或输了，还有些操之过急。

sentences.en: It is difficult, is it not, to see this result being overturned?
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 不过，这个结果恐怕很难被推翻，不是吗？

sentences.en: This is a flat margin of victory at the moment—56 percent to 44 percent.
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 目前双方的得票率是56%对44%。

sentences.en: It would be extraordinary to see that overturned in the space of a couple of weeks.
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 要在短短几个星期内推翻这个结果，会非常不寻常。

sentences.en: I think both candidates have agreed that there was extensive fraud in the electoral process.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 我认为两位候选人都承认，选举过程中存在大规模舞弊。

sentences.en: Both candidates have agreed that the suspect ballots need to be audited.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 两位候选人也都同意，可疑选票需要接受审查。

sentences.en: They haven’t agreed on exactly how to go about that.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 但他们还没有就具体如何开展审查达成一致。

sentences.en: We believe it’s the responsibility of the electoral institutions to go ahead and conduct that kind of broad audit, whether or not the candidates have agreed on every precise element of the process, they will have to do it, and we believe until they’ve done so it’s premature to be coming to any judgments.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 我们认为，选举机构有责任推进并开展这种广泛审查；无论候选人是否就程序的每一个细节达成一致，选举机构都必须去做。在完成审查之前，我们认为作出任何判断都为时过早。

sentences.en: It is worrying though, isn’t it?
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 但这仍然令人担心，不是吗？

sentences.en: I suppose it was all too predictable that democracy is an imperfect thing in Afghanistan and that undoubtedly there has been fraud, we’ve heard all sorts of reports that project there has been a measure of fraud, and whoever was going to lose in this election was going to say it’s been by unfair means.
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 我想，在阿富汗，民主并不完善，而且毫无疑问存在舞弊，这都是完全可以预见的。我们也听到各种报道称，存在一定程度的舞弊；无论最后谁输掉这场选举，都会说自己遭到了不公平的对待。

sentences.en: I agree with you that Afghanistan is a relatively new democracy.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 我同意，阿富汗是一个民主制度相对较新的国家。

sentences.en: That countries at this stage of democratic development often have difficulties of this sort.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 处于这个民主发展阶段的国家，往往会遇到这类困难。

sentences.en: That there’s not a tradition of good losers in societies at this level of political development.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 政治发展处于这种水平的社会，还没有形成坦然接受败选的传统。

w.m: phr.能够坦然接受失败的人

sentences.en: And in that sense, the problem we face is not unparalleled.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 从这个意义上说，我们面临的问题并不是绝无仅有的。

sentences.en: There are other countries who have gone through similar difficulties.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 其他国家也经历过类似困难。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, the fact is that millions of Afghans went out and voted in the expectation that their vote would count.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 不过，事实是，数百万阿富汗人走出去投票，是期待自己的选票能够真正起作用。

sentences.en: That numerous polls indicate that most Afghans are prepared to support either candidate as the victor.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 大量民意调查也表明，多数阿富汗人愿意支持两位候选人中的任何一位成为胜者。

sentences.en: That is that most Afghans have said that they could accept the person they didn’t vote for winning the election if that was the result.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 也就是说，大多数阿富汗人表示，如果选举结果如此，他们可以接受自己没有投票支持的人获胜。

sentences.en: So, while the problems we face are not unparalleled, the Afghan voters expect something better.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 所以，虽然我们面临的问题并非绝无仅有，但阿富汗选民仍然期待更好的结果。

sentences.en: James, I am so grateful to you.
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: I hugely appreciate you answering it and answering all the other questions as well.
sentences.speaker: BBC
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你回答了这个问题，以及其他所有问题。

sentences.en: Pleasure.
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: This is the end of part two of the interview.
sentences.zh: 访谈的第二部分到此结束。
sentences.asr_text: This is the end of part two of the interview.
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.zh: 第6至10题根据你刚才听到的内容提问。
sentences.asr_text: Questions six to ten are based on what you have just heard.
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: Question 6. What does the interviewee think both candidates need to do?
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 第6题：受访者认为，两位候选人都需要做些什么？

sentences.en: Question 7. What was the margin of victory at the time of the interview?
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 第7题：在本次访谈发生时，两位候选人的得票率相差多少？

sentences.en: Question 8. Who should be responsible for dealing with fraud in the election?
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 第8题：谁应该负责处理选举中的舞弊问题？

sentences.en: Question 9. What does the interviewee think of the problem in the Afghan election?
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 第9题：受访者如何看待阿富汗选举中的问题？

sentences.en: Question 10. What is the interview mainly about?
sentences.speaker: Ambassador Dobbins
sentences.zh: 第10题：这次访谈主要讨论什么？

sentences.zh: 第一部分听力理解到此结束。
